results.title: Homogeneity of corporate risk perceptions and systemic ...
results.content: This study employs text mining of risk factor disclosures to extract the risks perceived by financial institutions and measure the homogeneity of their perceptions. Section 4 illustrates the measures of risk perception homogeneity among financial institutions based on their textual risk disclosures, followed by the description of systemic risk measures, regression models. Methodologically, by measuring interconnectedness based on the homogeneity of risks perceived by financial institutions, this paper provides novel evidence on the relationship between interconnectedness and systemic risk, offering a fresh perspective rooted in corporate risk perception. This indicates that the banks generally have high homogeneity with other financial institutions regarding corporate risk perception. This indicates that increased connectedness, measured by greater homogeneity in risk perception among financial institutions, will exacerbate systemic risk. The empirical results, as tabulated in Tables 5 and 6, demonstrate that, irrespective of whether within banking or non-banking sectors, a surge in risk perception homogeneity of financial institutions is correlated with a pronounced escalation in systemic risk.
